text:
amy-partners: Quick heads-up — Zenith SI hit a hard stop on the private deploy test. gRPC connector fails with TLS handshake error when talking to our sidecar. @raj-solutions can you join the call? Need arch review + workaround.

raj-solutions: On it. Can you paste the root error and which image/tag you're running?

amy-partners: Error from customer logs:
```
error: grpc: failed to verify peer certificate: unknown CA
module: sidecar-connector v1.2.4
```
They're on our private image `redwood/sidecar:2026-03-18` with govcloud certs.

leo-eng: That generally means the image doesn't trust the customer's intermediate CA. Two quick options: (1) mount their CA into the image via init container (fast), or (2) enable our TLS passthrough mode to skip mTLS verification (needs config flag). Which do we prefer for a customer POC?

tess-field: Customer wants minimal infra changes. Can we do (1) as short-term? Schedule arch review in 30m?

ben-si-eng: I can prep a fallback HTTP adapter that avoids gRPC + mTLS negotiation. It's a ~30m change: set CONNECTOR_MODE=http-adapter and restart. Works for traffic <100rps.

maria-cs: Heads-up from Security: they require KMS envelope encryption + audit logs for any cert mounting. If we mount a CA, we must document KMS rotation steps.

amy-partners: Noted. @ben-si-eng can you draft the runbook for CONNECTOR_MODE and the CA-mount approach? We'll present both at the review. Also adding @oncall-bot to create an incident for tracking.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0017 — "Zenith SI private deploy: connector TLS fail". Pager on-call if severity escalates. https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-0017

raj-solutions: I'll join the 30m slot, bring logs and a small repro script. amy—can you DM me the customer's cluster kubeconfig? Prefer not to post here.

amy-partners: Sent DM. Thanks all — aim to close POC blocker before EOD. :thumbsup:
